environment: **Organization**: liminalfield (personal). NOT dgxc-digital — never move code, issues, secrets, or client material between the two orgs.

**Repository visibility**: **PUBLIC** (per gh); GitHub `liminalfield/liminal-git`, default branch `main`. Anything committed or pushed here is world-readable and cannot be un-published — treat every commit as a publication.
**Project**: `liminal-git` v1.1.0 — native git operations for Node.js, built on libgit2 via napi-rs. Rust (`Cargo.toml`) compiled to a `.node` addon, distributed as an npm package.

**Publishing**: the package declares a `files` allowlist (`index.js`, `index.d.ts`, `*.node`, `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`) and is not marked private, so `npm publish` would push to the public npm registry. Publishing a version is irreversible — npm unpublish is heavily restricted.
**Secrets management**: no CI secrets referenced in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
**CI/CD**: GitHub Actions `ci.yml` (build/test only — no publish step; releases are manual)
**Deploy targets**: none — the artifact is an npm package, not a deployed service
**Sensitive data locations**: none declared; no env files are gitignored, which is another reason not to write secrets into this tree
**Routine operations**: `cargo build`, `cargo test`, `cargo clippy`, `cargo fmt`, `npm test`, `npm run build` are routine here
soft_deny: Bash(npm publish:*) — publishes to the PUBLIC npm registry and cannot be undone; always confirm explicitly
Bash(cargo publish:*) — publishes to crates.io and cannot be undone; always confirm explicitly
Bash(git push:*) — this repo is public; pushing makes content world-readable, so confirm when pushing anything beyond routine branch work
